body:
The head does not merge with `main`. PR #2670 merged at 03:47 UTC and both PRs change `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_settings.rs` and `tests/tool_holder_reference.rs`. This is a real overlap, not a false conflict.

What to fix: merge `origin/main` into your branch (do not rebase), and keep both sides. In `tool_settings.rs`, main now calls `preview_inputs(state, exists)` and passes `(body, steel)` to `tool_preview::draw`. In the test file, main's #2016 and #2007 strings now read "In use: ...". Then push and ask for a re-check. No code review of this head was done.

Refreshed: merged origin/main (6df70dfc5) into the branch. Head 3c89af10f.

Conflicts resolved by hand in two places:
- `tool_cutting_rows`: kept main's plasma-recipe rule and our scroll fix, dropped the nested `CollapsingHeader`.
- `tool_holder_reference` test: kept our tab-click pin and main's wording.

Targeted gate green on the head. The full `camcraft-ui` lib run shows only the four `frame_cost` tests red; they are red on main too (known, #2766). Clippy `-p camcraft-ui`: 0 warnings.

Decision file: `docs/decisions/2014-tool-property-grid-v2` merge entry.

ready for a re-check

<!-- pr-reviewer: 3c89af10f1d1e011c910c6ec4ffd8ce768d85df1 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The trial merge with upstream main `744c0847b04d54cfc6e3e8b24a21520c40b6bcef` is clean. I checked the laws from that main revision.

What looks good:

- The form uses the shared property rows and preserves the Apply/Add commands.
- The tests cover the groups, folding, holder references, and Apply/undo.
- The prior conflict findings are met. The preview uses `preview_inputs(state, exists)`, and the holder tests keep main's wording.
- The PR changes no snapshot PNGs, dependencies, or process files.

Results, run locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2663` after the trial merge:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: all nine steps passed.
- UI build with `--no-run`: passed.
- UI library: 1260 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored.
- `boundary`: 3 passed.
- `boundary_picks`: 7 passed.
- `sinker_setup`: 2 passed.
- `tap_hand`: 3 passed.
- `theme_example`: 3 passed.
- `theme_files`: 17 passed.
- `waterjet_tool`: 1 passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Heavy lanes: the dry-run plan selects no lane for this diff.

Extra suites run:

None required by the extra selection rules. The diff changes no test data, fixture directory, golden directory, or importer code.

Mutations:

Not required. This is a UI layout change. It changes no posted G-code, geometry algorithm, stock simulation, or collision/gouge check. No goldens moved.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_cutting_rows.rs:184`: restore the feed widget for the waterjet recipe. `num_row` uses a length suffix. Thus the field shows `731.0 mm` under `Feed (mm/min)`. In inch mode it also uses length precision. Use a feed widget with the row label attached. Add assertions for the feed suffix in both unit modes. The current recipe test does not check this field.
2. PR body, line 3: add the before screenshot. The body has one after screenshot, but this UI change requires both views. Show the same tool and pane in both views. Store review screenshots only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the PR body.

Notes, not blocking:

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_cutting_rows.rs:66` still creates a nested `CollapsingHeader`. The body and `docs/decisions/2014-tool-property-grid.md:19` say that this header was removed. Make those descriptions agree with the intended layout.
- The local library run has no failures, including the frame-cost tests mentioned in the earlier comment.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Back to draft for the review findings of 2026-11-19 (marker `3c89af10f`). The fix push follows: the waterjet recipe Feed row now uses a feed-rate field (`num_feed_row`, suffix `mm/min` / `in/min`), pinned by `waterjet_recipe_feed_row_reads_as_a_feed_rate_in_both_unit_modes` in both unit modes. The nested `CollapsingHeader` is gone from `cutting_rows`: the grid's Cutting data group header is the one header, so code, PR body and `docs/decisions/2014-tool-property-grid.md` now state the same thing. A before screenshot goes on a new images-only `pr-screenshots` branch.

Ready for a re-check. Head `ae4f36fca`.

Both review points are fixed in the code, not the docs:

- The waterjet recipe Feed row now uses the feed widget (`num_feed_row`
  in `fields.rs`). It shows the `mm/min` / `in/min` suffix and the feed
  precision in both unit modes. Pinned by
  `waterjet_recipe_feed_row_reads_as_a_feed_rate_in_both_unit_modes`.
- The nested `CollapsingHeader` from the #2596 merge is deleted. The
  grid group header is the one header, in code, in this body, and in
  `docs/decisions/2014-tool-property-grid.md`.

Gate on this head: `camcraft-ui` lib 1250 passed, clippy
`--all-targets` clean. Four `frame_cost_probe` tests fail on my machine
(`frame_cost_probe.rs:278`); a stash test on the branch head without my
fix fails the same four, so they are the pre-existing #2766 machine
reds, and your runs on this PR show them green.

The body now carries before/after screenshots of the tool page (end
mill and waterjet nozzle), rendered headless at 1600x1500 from the same
seed in both builds.
